text: Managing a team is not easy, but good leaders can learn the skills they need. First, clear communication is important. You should explain tasks simply and make sure everyone understands their role. Second, delegation helps your team grow. Trust your colleagues and give them responsibilities. Third, regular feedback shows people that you value their work. It also helps them improve. Motivation is another key point: say "thank you" and celebrate success together. Finally, when conflicts happen, listen to both sides and find a fair solution. With these skills, you can build a strong and happy team.
